faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We have got answers

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Same-day delivery is available in Lagos, Abuja and major parts of Port Harcourt. Nationwide delivery usually takes 3-5 business days.

items.question: Are your products genuine?
items.answer: Yes. We only stock authentic appliances from trusted brands and provide manufacturer-backed warranties on eligible products.

items.question: Do you offer installation services?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer professional installation for ACs, refrigerators, washing machines, and more through our certified technicians.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return unused items in original condition within 7 days of delivery, subject to our returns policy and product eligibility.
